what: A live anchor of the Valun testnet's Basis tracker on Ergo testnet, from public reads on 2026-11-14: the notes GET /pilot/v1/ledger published (rows) and the one unspent box holding the tracker NFT (box_id; r5 is its R5 register). lib/avl.mjs must rebuild r5_digest from the rows in any order (fix inbox #62; TR-19).
rows_order: The rows are listed in their notes' timestamp order (ascending; equal timestamps in the order GET /pilot/v1/ledger listed them), the order upstream Basis 43e2173 inserts notes in (fix inbox #17). timestamp_order_digest is the digest of the rows inserted in the order listed; r5_digest is the digest of the same rows inserted in ascending debt-key order (TR-19), which the tracker anchors.

sources.rows: GET https://valun.tech/pilot/v1/ledger: each note's issuer_pubkey, recipient_pubkey and total (amount_collected, in nanoERG), the total as a decimal string, in denomination erg, the network's (the ledger lists notes in that denomination only; the match shows the tracker held no other). Left out: handles, participant ids, timestamps, redeemed and outstanding. All 250 notes were confirmed.
sources.box: The Ergo testnet explorer API, unspent boxes holding tracker_nft_id (boxes/unspent/byTokenId): exactly one box, box_id, created at height by transaction tx_id. r5_digest is its R5 after the AvlTree type byte 0x64 and before the flags 03, key length 20 (32) and 00 (no fixed value length).
sources.chain: GET https://valun.tech/pilot/v1/chain, read once: anchoring.confirmed_digest and local_digest equal r5_digest, confirmed_box_id equals box_id, confirmed_height equals height, state anchored.
sources.timestamp_order_digest: basis/avl-fixtures (anchor-audit --rows) on this file: the digest of the rows inserted in the order listed. anchor-audit's ledger mode gives the same digest for its timestamp order of the published ledger.
